content.introduction: The earnings calendar for October 5-9 includes notable reports from several companies. On Wednesday, a mid-cap stock is scheduled to report fiscal 2027 first-quarter results with Wall Street forecasting a wider loss of 30 cents per share. On Tuesday, before the market opens, Apogee Enterprises (APOG) is expected to report earnings of $0.63 per share, Lamb Weston (LW) at 0.59 per share, Neogen (NEOG) at 0.05 per share, and RPM (RPM) at 1.95 per share. There are no noteworthy earnings reports scheduled for Monday, October 5.
body:
The mid-cap stock is scheduled to report fiscal 2027 first-quarter results after the closing bell on Wednesday. Wall Street forecast a wider loss of 30 cents per share vs three cents a year ago, though analysts also expect year-over-year revenue growth of 94.0% to $124.57 million.
